# Adding a harness

What a new harness must implement, read from the code that requires it. Each step names the test that enforces it, and the tables show where the installed harnesses stand. `scripts/test-harness-definitions.ts` fails when this page is behind the code or an installed harness misses a step that has a check (a dash means only the enforcing test can tell).

## 1. The definition

Create `packages/host/src/harnesses/<harness>/index.ts` calling `installHarness(host, definition)` and add it to `packages/host/src/harnesses/harness-host.ts`; its place there is Mako's order. Give `presentation.mark` (viewBox, paths, tint), `diagnostics` (the SDK Mako drives it through, whether sessions run inside it, its sign-in's log scope), and each family below: the capability, `lacks(reason)` when the harness has no such thing, or `notBuilt(reason)` when Mako hasn't built it (a gap). Then run `npm run harness:descriptors`. Enforced by the types, `installHarness`, `test-harness-definitions.ts`, and `test:seventh-harness`, which installs a seventh harness and runs the session flows against it.

| Family | What it is | Claude Code | Codex | Cursor | OpenCode | Grok | Devin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `live` | Starts, streams, steers, answers and stops turns, and declares where it stands on each live capability. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `profile` | Its name, models, modes, settings and sign-in state, and the models Mako picks for it until the person does. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `decoder` | Turns the harness's native messages into Mako's decoded events, outside the driver, so recorded sessions replay as fixtures. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `acp` | The harness's ACP agent, when its live driver runs on one. | none | none | none | none | yes | yes |
| `accounts` | Which of the person's accounts a session runs as, and whether the harness reports it. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `connection` | A sign-in Mako drives from Settings. | none | none | yes | none | yes | none |
| `processProbe` | Matches the harness's own processes to its sessions, so Mako never reopens a session another process holds. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `nativeRunner` | Headless runs outside a live conversation. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `mcp` | The MCP servers the harness reads, for the MCP registry. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `skills` | The skills the harness reads, for the skill registry and for handing skills over. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `hooks` | Its hooks in every file it reads them from, created, edited, turned off and removed from Settings, each change previewed as a diff. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `commands` | Its custom commands in every folder it reads them from, created, edited and removed from Settings. | yes | none | none | yes | yes | none |
| `toolEditing` | Tool authoring from Settings. | none | none | none | none | none | none |
| `skillEditing` | Importing and removing skills in the harness's own folders. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `mcpEditing` | Its MCP servers in its own configuration: copied in from another harness, turned off and on, and removed. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `updates` | Finding, versioning and updating the harness's binary. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `usageHistory` | Spend the harness's own store records; without it, Settings › Usage shows what Mako measured. | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `artifactPreview` | Previews of files the harness writes as artifacts. | none | none | yes | none | none | none |

## 2. Live capabilities

Each is a field of the live driver: implemented with what implements it, or absent as `unavailable` (the harness has none) or `not-built` (a Mako gap), with the reason the window shows. Enforced by the types and `validateLiveDriver`. `npm run harness:doctor -- <harness>` prints the reasons, and the session flows run each declared capability on the real CLI.

| Capability | Driver field | What it asks | In the window | Claude Code | Codex | Cursor | OpenCode | Grok | Devin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Resume | `resume` | Reopening a session in a new process: how, what the next message does after Mako closes the process, a checkpoint of the session's source, and who else holds it. | Conversations reopen where they left off after their process closes. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Idle process | `resume` | Follows resume: Mako closes an idle conversation's process only when its session can be reopened. | An idle conversation's process closes, and the next message wakes it. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Process death mid-turn | `turnRecovery` | When a prompt counts as accepted and how a process death reaches the host, with the tests that kill the process mid-turn. | A turn whose process dies ends as failed, keeping what it did. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Fork | `fork` | A fork that is the harness's own copy of the session; a harness without one declares `transcript`, and the fork is a new session whose first turn reads the conversation's transcript. | Fork a conversation from any turn. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Steering | `steering` | A message sent into a running turn, and whether it lands at the next step or interrupts. | Messages sent during a turn reach it. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Compaction | `compaction` | Compaction Mako starts, or the harness's own automatic compaction. | Compact conversation, in the composer's menu. | implemented | implemented | by default | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Planning | `planning` | How the harness plans (a mode or a setting), how the plan reaches the plan card, and how a reply to it reaches the harness. | Plan mode, with the plan card. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Approvals | `approvalEvidence` | Whether the harness asks before acting, and whether it reports the decision it applied. | Approval cards before the agent acts. | implemented | implemented | harness has none | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Questions | `questions` | How the agent asks the person a question: a blocking request or a session question. | Question cards above the composer. | implemented | implemented | harness has none | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Modes | `modeSwitching` | Switching the session's mode natively, with the modes it offers. | The access menu changes mode mid-conversation. | implemented | implemented | no-op | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Subagents | `nativeAgents` | Observing the subagents the harness starts. | The Agents panel. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Background work on Stop | `backgroundStop` | How Stop ends background work, or the evidence that none outlives its turn. | Stop ends background commands too. | implemented | implemented | by default | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Context breakdown | `contextBreakdown` | An itemized account of what fills the context window. | What fills the context, in the meter's popover. | implemented | harness has none | implemented | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none |

## 3. Usage

Each is a field of the definition's `usage`: `implemented` with where the harness reports it, `harnessLacks(reason)` when it reports none, or `makoLacks(reason)` when Mako doesn't read it yet; after compaction, `byDefault(reason)` when the meter keeps its reading until the next reply. The composer's meter, Settings › Usage and the account rows read these, never whether data happened to arrive. Context breakdown and spend outside Mako come from the live driver and `usageHistory`. Enforced by `installHarness` and `test-usage-declarations.ts`, which replays every recording and fails on a reading a declaration rules out, or a declared one no recording shows.

| Reading | What it asks | In the window | Claude Code | Codex | Cursor | OpenCode | Grok | Devin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Context fill | Where the context fill comes from: the harness's own reading (`context` observations), or the main agent's last call (`call`). | The context meter in the composer. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Window size | Where the window size comes from: the harness's reports (`window`, or a reading's `size`), or its model catalog. | The meter's window size. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| After compaction | After a compaction, whether the harness says what is left (`compacted` with `after`) or the meter waits for the next reply. | The meter after a compaction. | implemented | implemented | by default | by default | implemented | by default |
| Context breakdown | The live driver's `contextBreakdown`. | What fills the context, in the meter's popover. | implemented | harness has none | implemented | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none |
| Tokens spent | Tokens the session spent (`spent` or `total` observations). | Tokens in the meter's popover and Settings › Usage. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Cost | What the session cost (`cost` or `costSpent`). | Cost in the meter's popover and Settings › Usage. | implemented | harness has none | harness has none | implemented | implemented | Mako gap |
| Missed calls | Whether the harness says a report left calls out (`unrecorded`). | A note when its totals leave calls out. | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none | implemented | harness has none |
| Spend by tool | Whether the harness reports what a single tool call, skill or MCP server spent, rather than a call's or turn's total. | Nothing yet: no harness reports it, and Mako never splits a call's spend among its tools by guess. | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none |
| Spend outside Mako | The `usageHistory` family. | Settings › Usage counts its sessions outside Mako. | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented | implemented |
| Reset credits | The accounts' `useResetCredit`, offered on the account's row. | Use a reset credit, on the account's row. | harness has none | implemented | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none | harness has none |
| Balance | The `balances` its accounts' usage readings carry: credit or money left beyond the plan. | Credit or money left beyond the plan, on the account's row. | implemented | implemented | implemented | harness has none | Mako gap | implemented |
| Switching at a limit | Whether Mako can offer another account when one nears its limit: selectable accounts whose `accountUsage` reads each one's own limits. | A line above the composer offering an account with room, when the one in use nears its limit or is refused. | implemented | implemented | implemented | harness has none | implemented | implemented |

## 4. Shared features

Features more than one harness has, under Mako's one name (`HARNESS_FEATURES` in `packages/host/src/contracts/harness-features.ts`), whatever the harness calls them. Declare each in the definition's `features`: `native(name, where)` for the harness's own form, and where Mako stands. `shownAs(via)` shows the harness's own; `TOOL_ROWS` shows its tool rows, named from its vocabulary; `makosOwn(note?)` runs Mako's own, which a harness can't lack where Mako has one; `byDefault(reason)` leaves it to the harness; `makoLacks(reason)` is a gap, `harnessLacks(reason)` none. Settings › Agents lists them under Mako's names, each with what the harness calls it. A name in this table can't be listed as a harness's own. Enforced by `installHarness` and `test-harness-definitions.ts`; `npm run audit:capabilities` prints them.

Bold is the harness's own, shown in Mako; "Mako's" runs Mako's own; "none here" means nothing Mako can drive, with the nearest thing the harness has in parentheses.

| Feature | What it is | Mako's own | Claude Code | Codex | Cursor | OpenCode | Grok | Devin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Goals | The agent keeps working, turn after turn, until a condition you set is met. | Mako asks the agent to continue after each turn until it reports the goal met or says what it needs, or until the goal's tokens reach its budget. | **/goal** | **/goal** | Mako's (its own: goals) | Mako's | **/goal** | Mako's |
| Code review | The agent reviews a set of changes and reports what's wrong. | Mako asks the agent to review the changes without editing them and to end its reply with the findings as data, which the transcript shows as the review's card. | **/code-review, /security-review, /ultrareview** | **/review** | Mako's | **/review** | Mako's | Mako's (its own: /loop) |
| Side questions | A question answered beside the turn, without interrupting it or joining the conversation. | Mako asks a copy of the session, and discards the copy when the side conversation closes. | **/btw** | **/side, /btw** | Mako's | **session.generate** | **/btw** | **/btw** |
| Scheduled prompts | A prompt that runs again on an interval. | – | /loop: Mako gap | none | none | none | /loop: Mako gap | none |
| Cloud runs | A conversation handed to the harness's cloud, or started there. | – | --cloud, /schedule: Mako gap | codex cloud: Mako gap | cloud agents: Mako gap | none | none | /handoff: Mako gap |
| Background sessions | A conversation goes on with no terminal open. | Mako runs every conversation in its host, with no terminal open. | Mako's (its own: claude --bg) | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's |
| File rewind | Files put back as they were before a turn. | Rewind restores Mako's workspace checkpoint from before the turn. | Mako's (its own: /rewind) | Mako's (its own: thread/revert) | Mako's | Mako's (its own: /undo, /redo) | Mako's (its own: /rewind) | Mako's (its own: /revert) |
| Worktrees | Work in a Git worktree of its own. | A Thread moves into a worktree of its own, and its conversations run there. | Mako's (its own: --worktree) | Mako's (its own: /worktree) | Mako's | Mako's (its own: worktrees) | Mako's (its own: -w) | Mako's |
| Computer use | The agent drives a browser or the Mac. | Mako's browser and computer control, through its `mako-computer` MCP server. | Mako's (its own: computer use) | Mako's (its own: computer use) | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's |
| Notifications | You hear when a turn ends or needs you. | Mako's desktop notifications. | Mako's (its own: PushNotification) | Mako's (its own: notify) | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's | Mako's |
| Folder trust | The harness asks before it trusts a project folder. | – | trust dialog: Mako gap | trust_level: Mako gap | none | **external_directory** | **folder trust** | workspace trust: Mako gap |
| Edit before approving | A command or tool input changed in its approval, then run. | – | updatedInput: Mako gap | none | none | none | none | editable commands: Mako gap |
| Plugins | Packages of commands, skills, agents and hooks the harness loads. | – | plugins, by default | plugins, by default | plugins: Mako gap | plugins, by default | plugins, by default | plugins, by default |
| Response style | A saved style for how the agent writes its replies. | – | output styles, by default | none here (personality) | none | none | none here (/personas) | none |
| Web search | The agent searches the web. | – | **WebSearch** | **web_search, web__run** | none here (webSearch) | **websearch** | **web_search** | **web_search** |
| Image generation | The agent makes or edits images. | – | none | **image generation** | **generateImage** | none | **image_gen, image_edit** | none |
| Code mode | The agent calls its tools from a script it writes. | – | none | **exec** | none | **execute** | none | none |

## 5. Only this harness

List what no other harness has in the definition's `unique`: its name, what carries it natively, and where it stands in Mako: `shownInTools(names)`, its tool rows, each name in its vocabulary; `byDefault(reason)`, it works in Mako's sessions with nothing to show; `noOp(reason)`, there is nothing in it to show; `makoLacks(reason)`, a gap. A shared feature, capability or usage field isn't listed here, even where only one harness has it; Settings › Agents marks those as that harness's alone. An artifact preview names its files (`artifactPreview`: interactive previews in the file viewer.). Enforced by `installHarness` and `test-harness-definitions.ts`.

| Harness | Feature | Native | In Mako |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cursor | Screen recording | the `recordScreen` tool: start, save or discard a recording of the screen | tool rows: `recordScreen` |
| Grok | X search | `x_search`, a server-side xAI search of X, reported by its title | tool rows: `x_search` |
| Grok | Video generation | the `image_to_video` and `reference_to_video` tools; `/imagine-video` | tool rows: `image_to_video`, `reference_to_video` |
| Grok | Announcements | `_x.ai/announcements/update` | nothing to show: They're xAI's product news for Grok's own pager, so Mako ignores them. |

## 6. Beside the definition

| Step | What to add | Enforced by | Claude Code | Codex | Cursor | OpenCode | Grok | Devin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Decoder fixtures | Real sessions recorded into `scripts/fixtures/native-decoding/<harness>`, until coverage lists no declared kind. | `test-harness-definitions.ts`, `test:decoders` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Saved history | A `SessionProvider` in `@mako/sessions`, added to `SAVED_HISTORY_READERS` (`readers.ts`), which the catalog, the detached daemon and its sharing identity all read. Each reader is made with the host's `NativeStores` and opens and writes a SQLite store only through it, so a fixture desk's strict stores keep it read-only. If the store holds the live wire, it locates records and feeds the live decoder (`AcpSavedTurns` for ACP); otherwise it reads through the vocabulary module. A JSONL store gets a follower. A reader built outside the package goes to `defaultCatalog({ readers })`, as the stand-in's does. | `test-harness-definitions.ts`, `test-follow-convergence.ts`, the session flows' `switch` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Record storage | The vocabulary's `storage`: each encoding the harness writes a record's file in, and each way its history departs from the record's own lines in order (`HistoryLayout`: continues, branches, rewinds, holds-undo, copies, generations), with the native field that marks it. The saved-history reader reads files through `record-files.ts`, which reads every declared encoding with offsets in plain bytes, and reads each layout the one way its definition gives, `readLineage` for a record that continues another. Look for each in the harness's source or store: compression or rotation of old records, a record a revert or fork starts that points into an earlier one, a current-leaf pointer, an undo kept until the next prompt, a second generation of the store. Each declared answer is proved against a store built for it. | `packages/sessions/test/record-storage.mjs`, which fails on a declared answer without a proof | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Decode pairs | A recorder in `scripts/harness-decode-pairs.ts` (a scripted model, or the harness's own with the person's sign-in linked in), and every scenario recorded with `--write`. Each difference between live and saved that stays has its reason in `pair.json`. | `test-decode-pairs.ts`, `test-harness-usage.ts` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Vocabulary | A module in `packages/sessions/src/harnesses/`, added to `VOCABULARIES`: every tool with its kind, keys, aliases and MCP names, its usage field map, its concepts (instructions, hooks, skills, commands, agents, MCP files, output, models), and its record storage. | `test-harness-vocabulary.ts`, `test-tool-identity.ts`, `audit:tools -- --unresolved` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Concepts checked against the build | An entry in `scripts/harness-self-report.ts`, then `npm run harness:self-report -- <harness>` and `npm run harness:concepts`. | `test-harness-concepts.ts` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Hooks, commands and MCP authoring | The `hooks`, `commands` and `mcpEditing` families, built on the shared editors in `packages/host/src/tools/authoring-*.ts` (hook files in matcher groups or flat, command folders and config keys, MCP servers in JSON or TOML with their switch: a key on the server or a list of names), each source in the harness's own order with its scope and trust; or `lacks`/`notBuilt` with the reason Settings shows.
